## ESS gaps

Requirements marked unsupported because ESS cannot carry their rule yet, by gap of the [gaps table](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps).

| Gap | Requirements |
|---|---|
| [G1](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps) | R5.5-1, R7.4.1-3, R7.4.1-4, R7.4.1-6 |
| [G3](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps) | R5.4-6, R5.5.1-1, R5.5.1-3, R5.6-1 |
| [G8](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps) | R5.5.1-2 |
| [G9](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps) | R7.1.1-4, R7.1.7-1 |
| [G10](/docs/design#7-lowering-to-ess-and-the-gaps) | R5.5.3-1 |

| R11.3.5-1 | The model does not allow the Sec-WebSocket-Version header field to appear multiple times in an HTTP response. |
| R11.3.5-2 | the profile does not model the opening handshake (section 4), so no Sec-WebSocket-Version header field is sent |
